messages:
kevin_partnerships: Quick context — Renewals asked if we can add a hardware 'starter' kicker to marketplace private offers for mid-market customers. They want a clear renewal path that ties committed spend to a 6–12 month HW credit, plus an announcement plan with our SI partners. Any major blockers?

natalie_sales: sounds useful. typical ask size? are we talking $50k/mo commit or smaller? need to know to model discount depth. :thinking_face:

sam_eng: technical note — marketplace SKUs for Dedicated vs Hosted are distinct. If we attach HW credits to a private offer, billing reconciliation needs a mapping table. not a showstopper but ops work.

maria_product: rough proposal: tiered credits based on ARR commit bands, e.g. 6–12mo commit -> 5% credit for $X+, 10% credit + HW credit for $Y+. Keep the public listing unchanged; private-offer terms drive the credits. We should limit HW credits to one-time onboarding hardware voucher (redeemable via partner).

devon_ops: agree with sam. also need to confirm marketplace contract language allows third-party voucher redemption. some marketplaces (esp gov/regional) block partner vouchers in private offers. I'll flag legal + cloud partner PMs.

kevin_partnerships: Natalie — what's renewal cadence ask? Are we doing immediate renewals or rolling into next term?

natalie_sales: renewal asks fall into two buckets: 1) customers on annual renewals want an onboarding HW voucher to accelerate install; 2) customers mid-term want a ramp credit to incent commit expansion. We should support both but with different redemption windows.

maria_product: proposal details (very compact):
```
- Eligibility: private offer + signed MSA
- Commit bands: $50k/mo (6mo min) -> 5% monthly credit; $100k/mo (12mo) -> 10% + $25k HW voucher
- Voucher expiry: 9 months from execution
- SI co-sell: require SI endorsement in private offer metadata for voucher to be active
- Renewal handling: unused voucher doesn't roll; credits applied against usage invoices automatically
```

kevin_partnerships: I like that. Two asks: 1) Can ops implement metadata flagging so marketplace-bot shows SI in offer? 2) Can we script the announcement bundle for partnered customers so SI gets co-marketing?

marketplace-bot: New marketplace guidance doc added: https://internal.redwood/integrations/marketplace/hw-kicker-guidance — includes required metadata keys and sample private-offer payload.

sam_eng: ops work is doable. sample mapping we need from billing team:
```
{ "private_offer_id": "PO-12345", "offer_type": "hw-voucher", "partner_id": "SI-678", "voucher_amount": "25000" }
```
I'll add validation for voucher_amount and partner_id.

devon_ops: looping in legal and cloud-partner PMs — @legal and @cloud-partner-pm please confirm voucher legality across marketplaces, especially APAC regions.

natalie_sales: next steps from sales side: I'll draft a few customer-facing email templates and a co-sell announcement template for SI partners. target: pilot with 3 customers next quarter.

kevin_partnerships: team, thanks. action items: Natalie -> templates + pilot list; Devon -> legal + marketplace policy check; Sam -> mapping + validation; Maria -> finalize pricing bands; I'll coordinate SI co-marketing. Back in a week for sync. :thumbsup:
